title: Gronin playbook trigger
description: The value that replaces the `trigger` property of specs/001-runtime-core/contracts/playbook.schema.json when this feature lands. Shape only, like the playbook schema: whether the source is configured, whether a pattern compiles, and where the payload may be referenced are checked by the runtime at load, not here. cron and manual are unchanged except that neither may declare a source or values.

schedule.description: Required when type is cron. Standard five-field cron expression.

source.description: Required when type is webhook. A source the deployment configures in sources.json; the playbook is refused at load when it does not (FR-310).

values.description: Every payload value the playbook uses (FR-322). Nothing else in a delivery reaches the run (FR-323).

at.description: A JSON Pointer into the delivery's body.

pattern.description: An RE2 expression the whole value must match. The runtime anchors it.

max_length.description: The most Unicode code points the value may hold.
